note: Shaded, grassy campground on M-139 in Benton Harbor, on the grounds of the House of David's Eden Springs Park (owned by the House of David 1908-1973, now being restored by volunteers); the adjacent historic park runs miniature-train rides on summer weekends. Campers report road noise and many full-time or semi-permanent residents (RV Life reviews, 2025). --Claude
summary: Found the operator's own one-page site (edenspringsparkandcampground.com, linked from its Google listing) and phone 269-927-3302. Confirmed 42 full-service pull-through gravel sites, year-round, showers, reservations required (by phone). Cleared the directory-only 50-amp and military discount; water/sewer now from the operator ('full-service'). No posted rate and no booking engine. Google Maps: 'Eden Springs Park RV Campground', open, 4.4 stars from 348 reviews, (269) 927-3302. RV Life: $$ tier (avg $40), 3.5 stars; RV Life campers paid $47 a night in 2024 and $57-59 in 2025-2026. Note rewritten (fields now hold sites/hookups/season; the cabin count and 'no website' text were wrong).
